ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low; predominately low-intensity pixels (dark gray/black) covering >95% of the visible surface with isolated high-intensity white clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark pigmentation across both lobes. Discrete high-intensity circular rings are located on the mid-left lobe and near the center-proximal region. Significant white crusting or cluster is visible on the distal tip of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central notch with an approximate internal angle of 110 degrees; depth is roughly 12% of the total vertical height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous jagged boundary; left lobe trailing edge displays high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations. Right lobe trailing edge exhibits irregular, higher-amplitude notches specifically toward the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the leading edges of both lobes, tapering to acute distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of three distinct high-contrast white circular rings: a vertical pair on the mid-left lobe and a single ring adjacent to the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Circular barnacle-attachment scars on the left and central fluke; significant white calcified/scarred tissue at the distal extremity of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: High-intensity white stippling/speckling pattern localized at the peduncle-fluke interface at the bottom center.
